workbench.title: Desktop Workbench
workbench.detail: OpenKB is starting its local Engine. Your documents and model settings remain on this computer.

starting.title: Starting local Engine
starting.detail: The Desktop Shell is completing its private connection to OpenKB.

ready.title: Local Engine is ready
ready.detail: The Desktop Workbench can now safely load knowledge and begin work.

unavailable.title: Local Engine is unavailable
unavailable.detail: The Engine is not ready yet. Retry when it becomes available.

knowledgeBases.loadErrorTitle: Could not read the active knowledge base
knowledgeBases.emptyTitle: Start with a Desktop Knowledge Base
knowledgeBases.emptyDescription: Create a new SQLite knowledge base or open an existing Desktop Knowledge Base. One Desktop Runtime works with one active knowledge base at a time.
knowledgeBases.createDescription: Choose a parent folder and a new name. OpenKB will create the knowledge-base directory, SQLite state, and raw-source directory there.
knowledgeBases.openDescription: Choose a knowledge-base directory created by OpenKB Desktop. Legacy CLI/Web knowledge bases are not modified.
knowledgeBases.nameRequired: Enter a knowledge-base name without a slash.
knowledgeBases.importDescription: Choose files or a folder, or drop assets here. OpenKB checks every item before independent import jobs begin.
knowledgeBases.importPathRequired: Enter a file or folder path.
knowledgeBases.dropSources: or drop files and folders anywhere in this workbench
knowledgeBases.noSourcesSelected: Choose files, a folder, or add a local path to inspect it.
knowledgeBases.legacyOfficeNotice: Legacy DOC/PPT imports preserve only best-effort text and metadata; images, tables, pages, slides, and layout are not retained.
knowledgeBases.noImportableSources: Choose at least one currently supported document.
knowledgeBases.importBatchComplete: Import batch complete: {{count}} documents are available.
knowledgeBases.originalUnavailable: The saved original failed its integrity check and this document is excluded from answers.

importSourceErrors.unsupported_import_format: This format is not supported yet.

knowledgeBases.importedDocument: {{name}} is ready for retrieval with {{evidence}} evidence blocks.
knowledgeBases.deduplicationD1: Reused processing for the identical normalized body.
knowledgeBases.modelCallBudget: This request may wait up to {{timeout}}s ({{remaining}}s call budget remaining).
knowledgeBases.failedDocumentsDescription: Review isolated imports and resume only the failed stage with a one-time model or timeout override.
knowledgeBases.failedDocumentsEmpty: There are no isolated documents in this knowledge base.
knowledgeBases.recoveryDescription: Completed raw, document, and evidence stages are reused. These values affect this recovery only and never change the knowledge-base defaults.
knowledgeBases.recoveryInvalidTimeout: Enter an initial response timeout between 1 and 60 seconds.
knowledgeBases.trayAvailable: Closing this window keeps OpenKB running in the system tray. Use the OpenKB tray icon, including the taskbar overflow area, to reopen it or quit the app.
knowledgeBases.runtimeRestored: Restored your last active knowledge base: {{name}}.
knowledgeBases.previousKnowledgeBaseUnavailable: Your last knowledge base is no longer available. Choose an existing knowledge base or create a new one.
knowledgeBases.trayRestored: OpenKB kept running in the system tray. Use the OpenKB tray icon, including the taskbar overflow area, to return here or quit the app.
knowledgeBases.engineRestarted: The local Engine restarted and OpenKB restored the active knowledge base.
knowledgeBases.readyDescription: This knowledge base is bound to this Desktop Runtime. Future imports, answers, and knowledge editing will happen here safely.

knowledgePages.empty: No user revisions yet. Create a Concept or Entity page to begin.
knowledgePages.newDescription: Write the first user revision for this page.
knowledgePages.authorityDescription: User revision {{revision}} is the SQLite authority and is materialized as Markdown.
knowledgePages.titleRequired: Enter a page title before saving.
knowledgePages.previewEmpty: Start writing to preview this Markdown page.
knowledgePages.saved: User revision saved and Markdown reader view refreshed.

modelSettings.title: Model defaults
modelSettings.description: These values apply to new model requests in this knowledge base. A document recovery override never changes them.
modelSettings.providerHelp: Choose DeepSeek for its official API. Choose Other to enter any OpenAI-compatible API URL and model name.
modelSettings.apiKeyConfigured: An API Key is configured in this knowledge base.
modelSettings.apiKeyRequired: Enter an API Key before model analysis can run.
modelSettings.storageDescription: This knowledge base stores its SQLite state, raw documents, and model configuration in its own folder. Application logs are kept under your Windows local application data.
modelSettings.deadline: Each logical model call is capped at {{seconds}} seconds.
modelSettings.invalidConcurrency: Enter a model concurrency between 1 and 8.
modelSettings.invalidTimeout: Enter an initial response timeout between 1 and 60 seconds.
modelSettings.diagnosticsDescription: Export only when you choose to. The ZIP excludes source-file content, model request and response bodies, credentials, and headers.
modelSettings.diagnosticsReviewDescription: Confirm the redacted bundle contents before choosing where to save it.
modelSettings.diagnosticsExcludes: It excludes source-file content, model request and response bodies, credentials, and authorization headers.

versionCandidates.title: Document version review
versionCandidates.description: Similar documents are linked to the same source only after your confirmation.

reconciliation.title: Knowledge conflicts
reconciliation.description: Compatible additions are published automatically. Conflicting Concept and Entity changes stay here until you review them.
reconciliation.choiceStaged: Review choice staged. It will not affect answers until you commit.
reconciliation.commitSaved: {{published}} published · {{kept}} kept. Review copies were cleared.

knowledgeBases.answersDescription: OpenKB builds a local evidence pack from available documents, then keeps the answer and its citations for review.
knowledgeBases.answerQuestionPlaceholder: Ask a question about the imported documents…
knowledgeBases.noAnswers: Ask a question to begin a grounded answer history.
